client_accountability.reason: Original direct client has no persistent client ledger; shared queue and sink cache remain available.

transport_audit.scope: Actual proxy observations of committed/cached responses checked against sink; does not measure pre-commit CPU or all crash schedules.

execution_trace_audit.scope: Runner process lifecycle and exact shared queue envelope checked against transport and committed effects.

sink.hash_scope: Full main database and WAL bytes, plus canonical full SQL table content; transient SHM excluded.

limitations: No desired execution subset is hard-coded as success: all A/B/C/D outcomes remain visible.
Budget and queue capability outcomes are separate from technical run validity.
A final effects table establishes duplicate committed effects, not how many retries or pre-commit CPU attempts occurred.
Replay exercise and unknown-state timing require the preserved transport/event trace in addition to this final-state audit.
Public queue cutoff is logical test time, independent of real sink commit timestamps and permit TTL.
No estimate of application benefit, statistical significance, or universal superiority is made.
